title: Replace wall-clock DateTime.now() reads with the injectable clock seam in bulk_prior_completion_b6_b8_test.dart and store_screenshots_test.dart
why: expungePriorCompletions writes purgedAt via DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() (lib/.../bulk_prior_completion_service.dart:337), which resolves through the same injectable core/time/local_day_clock.dart seam FakeLocalDayClock/useLocalDayClock already provide elsewhere in this suite. Instead of pinning that clock, the test reads real wall time before/after and asserts purgedAt falls in a 1-second-padded window (lines 514-521) — a real (if narrow) flake surface under slow/loaded CI, and strictly weaker than an exact-timestamp assertion the existing seam would allow. TQ-5's own Enforce line calls for exactly 'audit grep for DateTime.now(/Random( in files calling matchesGoldenFile' — store_screenshots_test.dart:108 is precisely that pattern (harmless today only because the CurriculumSummary.lastCompletionAt field it feeds is never rendered by CurriculumSummaryCard).
recommendation: Inject a fixed DateTime via useLocalDayClock(FakeLocalDayClock(...)) (with resetLocalDayClock() in tearDown) and assert purgedAt equals that fixed instant exactly; replace the two decorative DateTime.now() call sites with fixed constants.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'DateTime.now(' test/ finds no call sites in files under core/time's clock-seam contract that could instead use DateTimeFactory/useLocalDayClock
the B8 AC1 purgedAt assertion checks an exact fixed timestamp rather than a before/after window
